items.title: Oil Flows in Hormuz Strait 'Forever Altered,' Says Tom Kloza
items.summary: Tom Kloza, chief energy advisor to Gulf Oil, said that he expects a 'major head fake' from the oil market as the 'seeds' for the next oil rally have been planted and could take gas and diesel prices back up in the beginning of 2027. Kloza also discussed the continued impact that war with Iran has had on the oil market, and said that his view remains that oil flows in the Strait of Hormuz are 'forever altered' by the conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)
